nodes.label: Image Object Structure Rationale
nodes.rationale: Image fields in EmDash are rich objects { id, src, alt } instead of simple URL strings to support metadata and responsive component sizing.

nodes.label: entry.id vs entry.data.id Distinction Rationale
nodes.rationale: entry.id represents the URL-safe slug, while entry.data.id represents the database ULID for API calls, preventing query mismatch bugs.

nodes.label: Astro Cache Hint Rationale
nodes.rationale: Passing query cacheHint to Astro.cache.set enables automatic visual edit cache invalidation when content changes.

nodes.label: Server-Side Rendering Requirement Rationale
nodes.rationale: Requires page server-rendering (no getStaticPaths) to serve live, real-time dynamic CMS edits to users.

nodes.label: Standard vs Native Plugin Formats
nodes.rationale: Standard format uses JSON Block Kit for admin and runs in sandboxed isolates. Native format permits React, custom DB access, and SSR block components but runs un-isolated.

nodes.label: Trusted vs Sandboxed Execution Modes
nodes.rationale: Sandboxed plugins restrict network and database access using V8 isolates, whereas trusted plugins run in-process with full backend access.

nodes.label: Plugin Capabilities System
nodes.rationale: Enables fine-grained permission control (network, content, media, email, users) for standard/sandboxed plugins.

nodes.label: Portable Text to Markdown Conversion
nodes.rationale: CLI bidirectional conversion between rich Portable Text JSON and markdown makes content edits simpler for agents.

nodes.label: Optimistic Concurrency via _rev Tokens
nodes.rationale: Enforces read-before-write using revision tokens. Server rejects updates with 409 Conflict if another user modified the entry first.

nodes.label: Auto-Publishing by Default
nodes.rationale: CLI create/update commands automatically publish changes to keep read-after-write views consistent for automated agents.
